questions.question: What is the ratio of the total export of tea in 2012, 2014 and 2015 to the total export of coffee in 2013 and 2014?
questions.solution:
Total export of tea in 2012, 2014 and 2015 = 400 + 500 + 420 = 1320

Total export of coffee in 2013 and 2014 = 470 + 630 = 1100

∴ Required ratio = 1320 : 1100 = 6 : 5

questions.question: The total export of coffee is approximately what percent more than the total export of tea during the give years?
questions.solution:
Total export of coffee during the years = 450 + 470 + 630 + 500 + 600 = 2650

Total export of tea during the years = 400 + 350 + 500 + 420 + 480 = 2150

Required percentage = [(2650 – 2150)/2150] × 100 ≈ 23%

questions.question: The number of years, in each of which the export of coffee is more than 20% as compared to the export of tea in that year is:
questions.solution:
In 2013, export of tea = 350 and export of coffee = 470

Export of coffee is more than that of tea by = (470 – 350/350) × 100 = 34.28%

In 2014, export of tea = 500 and export of coffee = 630

Export of coffee is more than that of tea by = (630 – 500)/500 × 100 = 26%

In 2016, export of tea = 480 and export of coffee = 600

Export of coffee is more than that of tea by = (600 – 480)/480 × 100 = 25%

So, there are 3 years.

questions.question: A sum of Rs 5200 is divided amongst A, B, C, and D such that the ratio of shares of A and B is 2 : 3, that of B and C is 4 : 5 and that of C and D is 1 : 2. What is the difference between the shares of B and D?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The total sum of money = Rs. 5200

The ratio of the share of A and B = 2 ∶ 3

The ratio of the share of B and C = 4 ∶ 5

The ratio of the share of C and D = 1 ∶ 2

**Calculations:**

Simplifying the ratios to get the same unit by cross multiplication

Ratio of A and B = (2 ∶ 3) × 4

⇒ 8 ∶ 12

Ratio of B and C = (4 ∶ 5) × 3

⇒ 12 ∶ 15

Ratio of C and D = (1 ∶ 2) × 15

⇒ 15 ∶ 30

Ratio of A, B, C and D = 8 ∶ 12 ∶ 15 ∶ 30

Total sum = 8x + 12x + 15x + 30x

⇒ 65x = 5200

⇒ x = 80

Difference between the shares of B and D = 30x - 12x

⇒ 18 × 80

⇒ Rs. 1440

**∴ The difference between the shares of B and D is Rs. 1440**

questions.question: A pipe can fill a tank in 18 hours. In how much time (in hours) will another pipe operating at one-third the efficiency of the first pipe fill a tank whose capacity is 50% of that of the first tank?
questions.solution:
Let efficiency of first pipe be 1 unit

Total work = 18 [capacity of tank]

Efficiency of another pipe = 1/3

50% of the capacity of tank = 18/2 = 9

Required time = 9/(1/3) = 27 hr

questions.question: A trader sells two articles for Rs. 9520 each, one at a profit of 12% and the other at a loss of 15%. His overall percentage loss (correct to one decimal place) is:
questions.solution:
Total SP of both articles = 2 × 9520 = 19040

CP of first articles = 9520 × 100/112 = 8500

CP of second articles = 9520 × 100/85 = 11200

Total CP of both articles = 8500 + 11200 = 19,700

Loss = 19700 – 19040 = 660

∴ Loss percentage = 660/19700 × 100 = 3.4%

questions.question: A train X travelling at 72 km/h crosses another train Y travelling at 63 km/h (in opposite direction) in 18 seconds. If the length of train Y is two-third the length of X, the length of train X is:
questions.solution:
Let the length of the train X be 3a

The length of the train Y = 3a × 2/3 = 2a

Speed of train X = 72 km/hr and speed of Y = 63 km/hr

Relative speed, if opposite direction = 72 + 63 = 135 km/hr = 135 × 5/18 = 37.5 m/s

Total length = 3a + 2a = 5a

As we know

Speed = Distance/Time

⇒ 37.5 = 5a/18

⇒ a = (37.5 × 18)/5

⇒ a = 135

Length of train X = 3 × 135 = 405 m

questions.question: A certain sum amounts to Rs 12096 at 8% p.a in 5(1)/(2) years at simple interest. What will be the simple interest on the same sum at 10% p.a in 8 years?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A certain sum amounts to Rs 12096 at 8% p.a in 5(1)/(2) years at simple interest.

Simple interest on the same sum at 10% p.a in 8 years

**Formula used:**

S.I = (P × r × t)/100 

where P = Sum of money, r = Rate, and t = Time

**Calculation:**

A = 12096, t = 8% and time = 11/2

As we know,

⇒ A = P + (Prt/100)

⇒ 12096 = P + (P × 8 × 11)/(100 × 2)

⇒ 12096 = P + 11P/25

⇒ 36P/25 = 12096

⇒ P = 12096 × 25/36

⇒ P = 8400

Again,

⇒ P = 8400, t = 8 years and r = 10%

⇒ SI = Prt/100

⇒ SI = (8400 × 8 × 10)/100

⇒ SI = 6720

**Short Trick : **

Let principal be 100%

Rate for 1 year = 8%

Rate for 11/2 years = 8 × 11/2 = 44%

⇒ 144% = 12096

⇒ 100% = 12096/144 × 100

Now,

R = 10% and time = 8 years

Interest for 8 years = 80%

Simple interest = 12096/144 × 100 × 80

⇒ 6720

**∴ The simple interest will be 6720.**

questions.question: An item is sold for Rs. 702 at a profit of Rs. 162. If an additional profit of 10% is to be made, then the new selling price will be:
questions.solution:
SP of the item = 702

CP of the item = 702 – 162 = 540

New selling price of the article = 540 + 540 × 10/100 + 162 = 540 + 54 + 162 = 756

questions.question: A sphere is inscribed in a cube. What is the ratio of the volume of the cube to the volume of the sphere?
questions.solution:
Side of cube = a

Volume of cube = a³

Radius of sphere r = a/2

Volume of sphere = (4/3) × πr³ = (4/3) π × (a/2)³ = (a³/6) π

Volume ratio of cube to sphere = a³ : (a³/6) π = 6 : π

questions.question: What will be the compound interest on a sum of Rs. 31250, at 12% compound interest (interest compounded yearly) in 2(2)/(3) years?
In spite of an increase in the price of a commodity by 20%, the overall expenditure on it increases by 12%. What is the percentage decrease in the quantity of commodity consumed?
questions.solution:
Let price be Rs. 100 per kg and consumption be 100 kg

Hence, expenditure = 100 × 100 = 10000

Now, new price = 100 × 120% = 120

And, new expenditure = 10000 × 112% = 11200

Hence, new consumption = 11200/120 = 93.33

∴ Percentage decrease in consumption = [(100 – 93.33)/100] × 100 = 6.67% = 6(2)/(3)

questions.question: What is the area (in m²) of a triangular field whose sides measure 25 m, 39 m and 56 m?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For a scalene triangle, the area can be calculated directly using Heron's formula.

Semi-perimeter (s) = (25 + 39 + 56) ÷ 2 = 120 ÷ 2 = 60 m.

Area = √[s × (s − a) × (s − b) × (s − c)]

Area = √[60 × (60 − 25) × (60 − 39) × (60 − 56)]

Area = √[60 × 35 × 21 × 4] = √[176400] = 420 m².

**∴ The correct answer is 420 m².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Sides of the triangular field:

a = 25 m

b = 39 m

c = 56 m

**Formula Used:**

Heron's Formula for the area of a triangle:

Area = √[s(s − a)(s − b)(s − c)]

Where, semi-perimeter s = (a + b + c) ÷ 2

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/523f1946debf8239eebd6391ac53cf962bd6ce1194f2d2db325a30f519ba22af.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ s = (25 + 39 + 56) ÷ 2

⇒ s = 120 ÷ 2 = 60 m

⇒ Area = √[60 × (60 − 25) × (60 − 39) × (60 − 56)]

⇒ Area = √[60 × 35 × 21 × 4]

⇒ Area = √[(15 × 4) × (7 × 5) × (7 × 3) × 4]

Grouping the similar terms to find square roots:

⇒ Area = √[(4 × 4) × (7 × 7) × (15 × 5 × 3)]

⇒ Area = √[16 × 49 × 225]

⇒ Area = 4 × 7 × 15

⇒ Area = 420 m²

**∴ The correct answer is 420 m².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Area of Equilateral Triangle

For a triangle with all three equal sides (a), Area = (√3 ÷ 4) × a².

Area of Isosceles Triangle

For a triangle with two equal sides (a) and a base (b), Area = (b ÷ 4) × √(4a² − b²).

General Area of a Triangle

When the base length and the perpendicular vertical height are known, Area = (1 ÷ 2) × Base × Height.

questions.question: The average of 20 numbers is 80. The average of the first 10 numbers is 76.5 and next 7 numbers is 82. The 18th number is 3 more than the 19th number but 3 less than the 20th number. What is the average of 18th and 19th numbers?
questions.solution:
Sum of 20 numbers = 20 × 80 = 1600

Sum of first 10 numbers = 10 × 76.5 = 765

Sum of next 7 numbers = 7 × 82 = 574

Sum of 18th, 19th and 20th = 1600 – 765 – 574 = 261

Let 18th number be x

⇒ 19th number = x – 3

⇒ 20th number = x + 3

⇒ x + x – 3 + x + 3 = 261

⇒ 3x = 261

⇒ x = 87

Average of 18th and 19th number = (87 + 84)/2 = 85.5

questions.question: The radius of a solid right circular cylinder is 66(2)/(3)\% of its height. If the height is h centimetres then its total surface area (in cm²) is:
questions.solution:
Height of the cylinder = h cm.

r=66(2)/(3)\% ~h=(200)/(3)~\%~h

Radius of the cylinder r = (2/3) h

Total surface area of cylinder = 2 π r (r + h)

⇒ 2 π × 2h/3 (2h/3 + h)

⇒ 2 π × 2h/3 × 5h/3

⇒ (20/9) πh²

questions.question: A can do a piece of work in 15 days and B can do it in 22(1)/(2) days. They worked together for 6 days and the remaining work was complete by C alone in 6 days. A, B and C will together finish the same work in :
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/17fb01dfb962ea695a53d6cc4192a5e7d11b46b801f966b09456630f7f10443a.png] 

Total work = 45

Work done by A and B in 6 days = (3 + 2) × 6 = 30

Remaining work = 45 – 30 = 15

Let efficiency of C be x, then

⇒ 6x = 15

⇒ x = 15/6

⇒ x = 5/2

Total efficiency of A, B and C = 3 + 2 + 5/2 = 15/2

A, B and C together complete the work in = 45/(15/2) = 6 days
